+import Foundation
+
+/// One entry of the command palette: a title, how to find it and what it does.
+///
+/// ```swift
+/// Command("New Note", section: "Notes", symbol: "square.and.pencil",
+///         keywords: ["create", "add"], shortcut: CommandShortcut("⌘N")) {
+///     model.newNote()
+/// }
+/// ```
+///
+/// Two commands are equal when everything but the action is equal, so a list of commands can be
+/// compared and used with `onChange(of:)`.
+public struct Command: Identifiable, Sendable {
+    /// A stable identifier. Recent commands are remembered by it, so keep it the same across launches.
+    public let id: String
+    /// The name shown in the list and searched first, for example "New Note".
+    public var title: String
+    /// A second, smaller line under the title.
+    public var subtitle: String?
+    /// The section the command is listed under, for example "Notes". Commands without one are listed
+    /// without a header.
+    public var section: String?
+    /// An SF Symbol name for the icon.
+    public var symbol: String?
+    /// Other words that find the command, for example `["create", "add"]` for "New Note".
+    /// A keyword matches when it starts with the query.
+    public var keywords: [String]
+    /// The command's own keyboard shortcut, shown as a hint at the trailing edge of its row.
+    public var shortcut: CommandShortcut?
+    /// What the command does. The palette closes first, then runs it on the main actor.
+    public var action: @MainActor @Sendable () -> Void
+
+    /// Creates a command.
+    /// - Parameters:
+    ///   - title: The name shown in the list.
+    ///   - id: A stable identifier; defaults to the section and title, such as `"Notes/New Note"`.
+    ///   - subtitle: A second line under the title.
+    ///   - section: The section header the command is listed under.
+    ///   - symbol: An SF Symbol name.
+    ///   - keywords: Other words that find the command.
+    ///   - shortcut: The command's keyboard shortcut, shown as a hint.
+    ///   - action: What the command does.
+    public init(
+        _ title: String,
+        id: String? = nil,
+        subtitle: String? = nil,
+        section: String? = nil,
+        symbol: String? = nil,
+        keywords: [String] = [],
+        shortcut: CommandShortcut? = nil,
+        action: @escaping @MainActor @Sendable () -> Void = {}
+    ) {
+        self.id = id ?? [section, title].compactMap { $0 }.joined(separator: "/")
+        self.title = title
+        self.subtitle = subtitle
+        self.section = section
+        self.symbol = symbol
+        self.keywords = keywords
+        self.shortcut = shortcut
+        self.action = action
+    }
+}
+
+extension Command: Hashable {
+    public static func == (lhs: Command, rhs: Command) -> Bool {
+        lhs.id == rhs.id
+            && lhs.title == rhs.title
+            && lhs.subtitle == rhs.subtitle
+            && lhs.section == rhs.section
+            && lhs.symbol == rhs.symbol
+            && lhs.keywords == rhs.keywords
+            && lhs.shortcut == rhs.shortcut
+    }
+
+    public func hash(into hasher: inout Hasher) {
+        hasher.combine(id)
+        hasher.combine(title)
+    }
+}
+
+extension Command: CustomStringConvertible {
+    public var description: String {
+        "Command(\(id))"

+import SwiftUI
+
+/// The command palette: a search field, the matching commands in sections and a footer with the
+/// keys to use.
+///
+/// - Type to search; matched characters are highlighted.
+/// - ↑ and ↓ move the selection (skipping section headers, wrapping at the ends), ↩ runs the
+///   selected command, ⎋ closes the palette. A click or tap runs a command too.
+/// - With an empty search field, recently run commands are listed first.
+///
+/// Usually you show it with ``SwiftUI/View/commandPalette(isPresented:commands:recents:shortcut:placeholder:)``.
+/// Use the view directly to put it somewhere else, or with
+/// ``SwiftUI/View/commandPalette(isPresented:shortcut:palette:)`` to change its parameters.
+@MainActor
+public struct CommandPaletteView: View {
+    private let commands: [Command]
+    private let placeholder: String
+    private let autofocus: Bool
+    private let queryBinding: Binding<String>?
+    private let onDismiss: () -> Void
+
+    @ObservedObject private var recents: RecentCommandsStore
+    @State private var query: String
+    @State private var selection: CommandPaletteSelection
+    @FocusState private var isSearchFieldFocused: Bool
+
+    /// Creates a palette.
+    /// - Parameters:
+    ///   - commands: All commands, in the order they are listed when the search field is empty.
+    ///   - recents: Where recently run commands are remembered; ``RecentCommandsStore/shared`` when `nil`.
+    ///   - placeholder: The search field's placeholder.
+    ///   - initialQuery: Text already in the search field, for example to restore a search.
+    ///   - initialSelection: The id of the command selected first; the first command when `nil`.
+    ///   - autofocus: Puts the cursor in the search field when the palette appears.
+    ///   - onDismiss: Called when the palette should close: after ⎋ and before a command runs.
+    public init(
+        commands: [Command],
+        recents: RecentCommandsStore? = nil,
+        placeholder: String = "Search for a command…",
+        initialQuery: String = "",
+        initialSelection: Command.ID? = nil,
+        autofocus: Bool = true,
+        queryBinding: Binding<String>? = nil,
+        onDismiss: @escaping () -> Void = {}
+    ) {
+        let store = recents ?? .shared
+        self.commands = commands
+        self.placeholder = placeholder
+        self.autofocus = autofocus
+        self.queryBinding = queryBinding
+        self.onDismiss = onDismiss
+        self._recents = ObservedObject(wrappedValue: store)
+        self._query = State(initialValue: queryBinding?.wrappedValue ?? initialQuery)
+
+        let rows = CommandPaletteResults.rows(for: CommandPaletteResults.sections(
+            for: queryBinding?.wrappedValue ?? initialQuery, in: commands, recentIDs: store.ids
+        ))
+        var selection = CommandPaletteSelection(rows: rows)
+        if let initialSelection {
+            selection.select(commandID: initialSelection)
+        }
+        self._selection = State(initialValue: selection)
+    }
+
+    public var body: some View {
+        VStack(spacing: 0) {
+            searchField
+            Divider()
+            results
+            Divider()
+            footer
+        }
+        .frame(maxWidth: 640)
+        .paletteBackground(cornerRadius: 22)
+        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.22), radius: 30, y: 14)
+        .task {
+            // After the palette is on screen; focus set during the first layout can be lost.
+            if autofocus {
+                isSearchFieldFocused = true
+            }
+        }
+        .onChange(of: queryBinding?.wrappedValue) { _, value in
+            if let value, value != query { query = value }
+        }
+        .onChange(of: query) { _, _ in
+            if queryBinding?.wrappedValue != query { queryBinding?.wrappedValue = query }
+            // A new search selects its best match.
+            selection.update(rows: makeRows())
+        }
+        .onChange(of: commands) { _, _ in
+            selection.update(rows: makeRows(), keepingSelection: true)
+        }
+        #if os(macOS)
+        .onExitCommand(perform: onDismiss)
+        #endif
+        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
+        .accessibilityLabel(Text("Command palette"))
+    }
+
+    // MARK: - Search field
+
+    private var searchField: some View {
+        HStack(spacing: 10) {
+            Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
+                .font(.system(size: 18, weight: .medium))
+                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+
+            TextField(placeholder, text: $query)
+                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
+                .font(.system(size: 20))
+                .focused($isSearchFieldFocused)
+                .autocorrectionDisabled()
+                #if os(iOS)
+                .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
+                .submitLabel(.go)
+                #endif
+                .onSubmit(runSelection)
+                .onKeyPress(.downArrow) {
+                    selection.moveDown()
+                    return .handled
+                }
+                .onKeyPress(.upArrow) {
+                    selection.moveUp()
+                    return .handled
+                }
+                .onKeyPress(.escape) {
+                    onDismiss()
+                    return .handled
+                }
+
+            if !query.isEmpty {
+                Button {
+                    query = ""
+                } label: {
+                    Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill")
+                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+                }
+                .buttonStyle(.plain)
+                .accessibilityLabel(Text("Clear search"))
+            }
+
+            KeyCap(label: "esc")
+        }
+        .padding(.horizontal, 18)
+        .padding(.vertical, 15)
+    }
+
+    // MARK: - Results
+
+    @ViewBuilder
+    private var results: some View {
+        if selection.rows.isEmpty {
+            emptyState
+        } else {
+            ScrollViewReader { proxy in
+                ScrollView {
+                    LazyVStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
+                        ForEach(selection.rows) { row in
+                            switch row {
+                            case .header(_, let title):
+                                SectionHeaderView(title: title)
+                            case .command(let item):
+                                Button {
+                                    run(item)
+                                } label: {
+                                    CommandRowView(item: item, isSelected: item.id == selection.selectedRowID)
+                                }
+                                .buttonStyle(.plain)
+                                .id(item.id)
+                                .accessibilityAddTraits(item.id == selection.selectedRowID ? .isSelected : [])
+                            }
+                        }
+                    }
+                    .padding(8)
+                }
+                .frame(maxHeight: 420)
+                .onChange(of: selection.selectedRowID) { _, id in
+                    guard let id else { return }
+                    proxy.scrollTo(id)
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private var emptyState: some View {
+        VStack(spacing: 8) {
+            Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
+                .font(.system(size: 26, weight: .light))
+                .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
+            Text("No commands match “\(query)”")
+                .font(.callout)
+                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+        }
+        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 160)
+    }
+
+    // MARK: - Footer
+
+    private var footer: some View {
+        HStack(spacing: 14) {
+            hint(["↑", "↓"], "Navigate")
+            hint(["↩"], "Run")
+            hint(["esc"], "Close")
+            Spacer()
+            Text(countLabel)
+                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+        }
+        .font(.caption)
+        .padding(.horizontal, 18)
+        .padding(.vertical, 10)
+    }
+
+    private func hint(_ keys: [String], _ label: LocalizedStringKey) -> some View {
+        HStack(spacing: 4) {
+            ForEach(keys, id: \.self) { KeyCap(label: $0) }
+            Text(label)
+                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private var countLabel: String {
+        let count = Set(selection.rows.compactMap { $0.item?.command.id }).count
+        return count == 1 ? "1 command" : "\(count) commands"
+    }
+
+    // MARK: - Actions
+
+    private func makeRows() -> [CommandPaletteRow] {
+        CommandPaletteResults.rows(for: CommandPaletteResults.sections(
+            for: query, in: commands, recentIDs: recents.ids
+        ))
+    }
+
+    private func runSelection() {
+        guard let item = selection.selectedItem else { return }
+        run(item)
+    }
+
+    /// Remembers the command, closes the palette, then runs the command.
+    private func run(_ item: CommandPaletteItem) {
+        let command = item.command
+        recents.record(command)
+        onDismiss()
+        command.action()
+    }
+}

+import FloatingPanel
+import SwiftUI
+
+/// Width is measured inside the detail column, after the library sidebar.
+enum ChavrusaReaderWorkspaceWidthPolicy {
+    static func canDock(detailWidth: CGFloat, minimumReaderWidth: CGFloat) -> Bool {
+        detailWidth.isFinite && detailWidth >= minimumReaderWidth + 300 + 18
+    }
+}
+
+/// The original workspace's HStack, resize handle and FloatingPanel composition.
+/// Keep Reader in one structural position as the native window/sidebar changes;
+/// the original TextKit instance can then preserve its source anchor on reflow.
+struct ChavrusaReaderWorkspaceLayout<Reader: View, Panel: View, ResizeHandle: View>: View {
+    let reader: Reader
+    let panel: Panel
+    let resizeHandle: ResizeHandle
+    let panelWidth: CGFloat
+    let showPanel: Bool
+    let floats: Bool
+    @Binding var floatingState: FloatingPanelState?
+    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection
+
+    var body: some View {
+        HStack(spacing: 0) {
+            reader
+                .environment(\.layoutDirection, layoutDirection)
+                .geometryGroup()
+                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
+            if showPanel && !floats {
+                resizeHandle.transition(.opacity)
+                panel
+                    .environment(\.layoutDirection, layoutDirection)
+                    .frame(width: panelWidth)
+                    .transition(.opacity)
+                    .clipped()
+                    .allowsHitTesting(showPanel)
+            }
+        }
+        .animation(.snappy(duration: 0.42, extraBounce: 0), value: showPanel)
+        .floatingPanel { _ in
+            if showPanel && floats { panel }
+        }
+        .floatingPanelState($floatingState)
+        .floatingPanelLayout(StudyContentFloatingPanelLayout())
+        .floatingPanelSurfaceAppearance(.transparent(cornerRadius: 26))
+    }
+}

+/// The pinned browser presents its overview over the current browser context.
+/// This context-sized anchor keeps the existing reader hierarchy in place;
+/// it neither rehosts the reader nor writes its scroll/selection state.
+struct ReaderOverviewPresentation<Overview: View>: View {
+    @Binding var isPresented: Bool
+    let onDismiss: () -> Void
+    let overview: Overview
+
+    init(isPresented: Binding<Bool>, onDismiss: @escaping () -> Void = {},
+         @ViewBuilder overview: () -> Overview) {
+        _isPresented = isPresented
+        self.onDismiss = onDismiss
+        self.overview = overview()
+    }
+
+    var body: some View {
+        ReaderOverviewPresentationAnchor(isPresented: $isPresented, onDismiss: onDismiss, overview: overview)
+            // A transparent representable still has a SwiftUI hosting layer.
+            // The closed presentation must not intercept reader pan gestures.
+            .allowsHitTesting(isPresented)
+    }

+private struct ReaderOverviewPresentationAnchor<Overview: View>: UIViewControllerRepresentable {
+    @Binding var isPresented: Bool
+    let onDismiss: () -> Void
+    let overview: Overview
+
+    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> ReaderOverviewPresentationController {
+        let controller = ReaderOverviewPresentationController()
+        controller.loadViewIfNeeded()
+        return controller
+    }
+
+    func sizeThatFits(_ proposal: ProposedViewSize, uiViewController: ReaderOverviewPresentationController,
+                      context: Context) -> CGSize? {
+        guard let width = proposal.width, let height = proposal.height,
+              width.isFinite, height.isFinite, width > 0, height > 0 else { return nil }
+        // The clear UIKit anchor has no intrinsic content size. Its actual
+        // view must accept the context proposal, not just its outer frame.
+        return CGSize(width: width, height: height)
+    }

+        controller.configure(
+            isPresented: isPresented,
+            // A new hosting controller owns its own navigation/accessibility
+            // graph. Forward only semantic public values, never the source
+            // host's complete environment and private graph ownership.
+            overview: AnyView(overview
+                .environment(\.locale, context.environment.locale)
+                .environment(\.layoutDirection, context.environment.layoutDirection)
+                .environment(\.colorScheme, context.environment.colorScheme)
+                .environment(\.dynamicTypeSize, context.environment.dynamicTypeSize)),
+            onDismiss: {
+                isPresented = false
+                onDismiss()
+            }
+        )
+    }
+
+    static func dismantleUIViewController(_ controller: ReaderOverviewPresentationController, coordinator: ()) {
+        controller.tearDownPresentation()
+    }
+}

+final class ReaderOverviewPresentationController: UIViewController {
+    private var wantsOverview = false
+    private var overview = AnyView(EmptyView())
+    private var onDismiss: (() -> Void)?
+    private var hostingController: UIHostingController<AnyView>?
+    private weak var presentationContext: UIViewController?
+    private var previousDefinesPresentationContext: Bool?
+    private var isTransitioning = false
+    private var updateScheduled = false

+        // UIKit's context must permit interaction with its presented content.

+    }

+    }

+    override func viewDidLayoutSubviews() {

+        scheduleUpdate()
+    }

+              view.bounds.width > 0, view.bounds.height > 0,

+    }

+    private weak var reorderingCurrentCell: UICollectionViewCell?
+    private var reorderTrackingDisplayLink: CADisplayLink?
+    private var lastContentOffset: CGPoint?
+    private var onReorderTick: ((TimeInterval) -> Void)?

+        collectionView.insertSubview(view, at: 0)
+    }

+    isolated deinit {

+    }

+    /// Positions the flare over the current tab.

+    }

+        isReordering = false
+        reorderingCurrentCell = nil
+        collectionView?.layoutIfNeeded()
+        update(animated: true)
+    }
+
+    // Preview hiding takes precedence over scroll hiding.
+    private func applyAlpha() {
+        guard let previewedTabIndex, previewedTabIndex == currentIndex() else {
+            view.alpha = hideAlpha
+            return
+        }
+        view.alpha = 0
+    }
+

+        stopReorderTracking()
+        let link = CADisplayLink(target: WeakDisplayLinkProxy(target: self), selector: #selector(WeakDisplayLinkProxy.tick(_:)))

+        reorderTrackingDisplayLink = link
+    }
+
+    private func stopReorderTracking() {
+        reorderTrackingDisplayLink?.invalidate()
+        reorderTrackingDisplayLink = nil
+    }
+
+    /// Animates between insertion slots instead of copying the placeholder's jumps.
+    private func trackToCurrentTabCell(elapsedTime: TimeInterval) {
+        guard let collectionView else {
+            endReorder()
+            return
+        }

+            endReorder()
+            return
+        }

+        // Model indices change before UIKit finishes moving the cells.

+        updateFrame(cell.frame, animated: true)
+    }

+    private func updateFrame(_ cellFrame: CGRect, animated: Bool) {
+        let frame = cellFrame.insetBy(dx: -rampWidth, dy: 0)
+        let contentOffset = collectionView?.contentOffset
+        // Scrolling already moves the flare; only animate changes between insertion slots.
+        let shouldAnimate = animated && contentOffset == lastContentOffset && !UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled
+        lastContentOffset = contentOffset
+        guard view.frame != frame else { return }

+        view.layer.removeAnimation(forKey: "reorder")
+        view.frame = frame
+        guard shouldAnimate else { return }
+        let animation = CABasicAnimation(keyPath: "position")
+        animation.fromValue = position
+        animation.duration = 0.15
+        animation.timingFunction = CAMediaTimingFunction(name: .easeInEaseOut)
+        view.layer.add(animation, forKey: "reorder")
+    }

+
+/// Draws the active iPad tab background: rounded top corners and concave bottom fillets that flare
+/// outward so the tab merges into the toolbar below. Mirrors the macOS tab shape in UIKit coordinates.
+///
+/// The tab body is the bounds inset by `rampSize.width` on each side; the ramps flare to the edges, so

+final class TabFlaredBackgroundView: UIView {

+        didSet { setNeedsLayout() }
+    }
+
+    /// Bottom-side concave fillet: width spreads past the tab body, height reaches up the side.
+    var rampSize: CGSize = CGSize(width: 10, height: 10) {
+        didSet { setNeedsLayout() }
+    }

+        didSet { applyFillColor() }
+    }

+        // swiftlint:disable:next force_cast
+        layer as! CAShapeLayer
+    }
+
+    override class var layerClass: AnyClass { CAShapeLayer.self }
+
+    override init(frame: CGRect) {
+        super.init(frame: frame)
+        isUserInteractionEnabled = false
+        applyFillColor()
+    }
+
+    @available(*, unavailable)
+    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
+        fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented")
+    }

+    override func layoutSubviews() {
+        super.layoutSubviews()
+        shapeLayer.path = Self.path(in: bounds, topCornerRadius: topCornerRadius, rampSize: rampSize)
+    }

+        super.traitCollectionDidChange(previousTraitCollection)

+        }

+    /// cubic Béziers matching the Figma export (`C14.4772 23 10 18.5228 10 13`), whose control points

+    /// `CAShapeLayer` renders y-down, which flips the concave fillet into a bump.

+        guard rect.width > 0, rect.height > 0 else { return path }

+        let rampHeight = max(0, min(rampSize.height, rect.height))

+        let bottom = rect.maxY
+
+        // Bottom edge, foot to foot.
+        path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: bottom))
+        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: bottom))
+
+        // Right ramp fillet.
+        path.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: bodyRight, y: bottom - rampHeight),
+                      control1: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX - rampWidth * control, y: bottom),
+                      control2: CGPoint(x: bodyRight, y: bottom - rampHeight * (1 - control)))
+
+        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: bodyRight, y: top + corner))
+        path.addArc(tangent1End: CGPoint(x: bodyRight, y: top),
+                    tangent2End: CGPoint(x: bodyRight - corner, y: top),
+                    radius: corner)
+
+        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: bodyLeft + corner, y: top))
+        path.addArc(tangent1End: CGPoint(x: bodyLeft, y: top),
+                    tangent2End: CGPoint(x: bodyLeft, y: top + corner),
+                    radius: corner)
+
+        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: bodyLeft, y: bottom - rampHeight))
+
+        // Left ramp fillet.
+        path.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: bottom),
+                      control1: CGPoint(x: bodyLeft, y: bottom - rampHeight * (1 - control)),
+                      control2: CGPoint(x: rect.minX + rampWidth * control, y: bottom))
+

+            delegate?.tabViewCellDidEndSwipe(self)
+        case .cancelled, .failed:

+            canDelete = false
+            delegate?.tabViewCellDidEndSwipe(self)
+        default:

+        }
+    }

+        self.documents = documents
+        self.selectedID = selectedID
+        self.layoutMode = layoutMode

+import CoreGraphics
+
+/// Single source of truth for the tabs strip's per-tab width and add-tab-button placement, so the
+/// two can never derive inconsistent thresholds from the same stripWidth/tabsCount independently.
+struct TabsBarLayout {
+
+    let itemWidth: CGFloat
+    let isFloored: Bool
+    let addTabButtonLeadingOffset: CGFloat
+    let addTabButtonContentInsetRight: CGFloat
+
+    init(stripWidth: CGFloat, tabsCount: Int, minItemWidth: CGFloat, maxItemWidth: CGFloat,
+         buttonWidth: CGFloat, buttonGap: CGFloat) {
+        guard stripWidth > 0 else {
+            itemWidth = 0
+            isFloored = false
+            addTabButtonLeadingOffset = 0
+            addTabButtonContentInsetRight = 0
+            return
+        }
+
+        let reservedWidth = max(0, stripWidth - buttonWidth - buttonGap)
+        itemWidth = Self.itemWidth(availableWidth: reservedWidth, visibleItems: tabsCount,
+                                    minWidth: minItemWidth, maxWidth: maxItemWidth)
+        isFloored = itemWidth > 0 && itemWidth <= minItemWidth
+
+        let contentWidth = CGFloat(tabsCount) * itemWidth
+        addTabButtonLeadingOffset = isFloored ? max(0, stripWidth - buttonWidth) : contentWidth + buttonGap
+        addTabButtonContentInsetRight = isFloored ? buttonWidth + buttonGap : 0
+    }
+
+    /// Equal share of the strip, capped at `maxWidth` then floored at `minWidth` (floor wins).
+    static func itemWidth(availableWidth: CGFloat, visibleItems: Int, minWidth: CGFloat, maxWidth: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
+        guard visibleItems > 0 else { return 0 }
+        var width = availableWidth / CGFloat(visibleItems)
+        width = min(width, maxWidth)
+        width = max(width, minWidth)
+        return width
+    }
+}

+    let buttonsStack = UIStackView()
+    let buttonsBackground = UIView()

+    private static func collectionViewLeadingConstant(for firstTabLeadingMargin: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
+        firstTabLeadingMargin - TabsBarViewController.Constants.tabRampSize.width
+    }

+        layout.minimumInteritemSpacing = 0

+        collectionView.showsVerticalScrollIndicator = false

+
+        buttonsStack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
+        buttonsStack.axis = .horizontal
+        buttonsStack.setContentHuggingPriority(.required, for: .horizontal)
+        buttonsStack.setContentCompressionResistancePriority(.required, for: .horizontal)

+        addSubview(buttonsBackground)
+        addSubview(buttonsStack)

+/// Folds tabs at the strip's edges and beside the pinned selection.
+final class TabsBarCollectionViewLayout: UICollectionViewFlowLayout {
+
+    var currentIndex: (() -> Int?)?
+    var currentTabDragOffset: CGFloat = 0 {
+        didSet {
+            if currentTabDragOffset != oldValue { invalidateLayout() }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override func shouldInvalidateLayout(forBoundsChange newBounds: CGRect) -> Bool {
+        true
+    }
+
+    override func layoutAttributesForElements(in rect: CGRect) -> [UICollectionViewLayoutAttributes]? {
+        // The outgoing tab remains exposed until its neighbor finishes folding over it.
+        let expandedRect = rect.insetBy(dx: -itemSize.width / 2, dy: 0)
+        guard let originalAttributes = super.layoutAttributesForElements(in: expandedRect) else { return nil }
+        var attributes = originalAttributes.compactMap { layoutAttributesForItem(at: $0.indexPath) }
+        guard let collectionView,
+              let index = currentIndex?(),
+              collectionView.numberOfSections > 0, index >= 0,
+              index < collectionView.numberOfItems(inSection: 0) else {
+            return attributes
+        }
+        // The selected tab and its edge hints can be far outside their original positions.
+        for item in max(0, index - 1)...min(collectionView.numberOfItems(inSection: 0) - 1, index + 1) {
+            let indexPath = IndexPath(item: item, section: 0)
+            guard !attributes.contains(where: { $0.indexPath == indexPath }),
+                  let pinned = layoutAttributesForItem(at: indexPath) else { continue }
+            attributes.append(pinned)
+        }
+        return attributes
+    }
+
+    override func layoutAttributesForItem(at indexPath: IndexPath) -> UICollectionViewLayoutAttributes? {
+        attributesForItem(at: indexPath, dragOffset: currentTabDragOffset)
+    }
+
+    func frameForCurrentTabAtRest() -> CGRect? {
+        guard let index = currentIndex?(), let collectionView,
+              collectionView.numberOfSections > 0,
+              index >= 0, index < collectionView.numberOfItems(inSection: 0) else { return nil }
+        return attributesForItem(at: IndexPath(item: index, section: 0), dragOffset: 0)?.frame
+    }
+
+    private func attributesForItem(at indexPath: IndexPath, dragOffset: CGFloat) -> UICollectionViewLayoutAttributes? {
+        guard let collectionView, indexPath.section >= 0, indexPath.section < collectionView.numberOfSections,
+              indexPath.item >= 0, indexPath.item < collectionView.numberOfItems(inSection: indexPath.section) else { return nil }
+        guard let attributes = super.layoutAttributesForItem(at: indexPath)?.copy() as? UICollectionViewLayoutAttributes else {
+            return super.layoutAttributesForItem(at: indexPath)
+        }
+        let leading = collectionView.bounds.minX + collectionView.adjustedContentInset.left
+        let trailing = max(leading, collectionView.bounds.maxX - collectionView.adjustedContentInset.right - attributes.frame.width)
+        let current = currentIndex?()
+        let lastItem = collectionView.numberOfItems(inSection: indexPath.section) - 1
+        let peek = min(attributes.frame.width / 2, (trailing - leading) / 2)
+        var origin = attributes.frame.minX
+        if indexPath.item == current {
+            let minimum = leading + (indexPath.item > 0 ? peek : 0)
+            let maximum = trailing - (indexPath.item < lastItem ? peek : 0)
+            let restingOrigin = min(max(origin, minimum), maximum)
+            attributes.frame.origin.x = min(max(restingOrigin + dragOffset, leading), trailing)
+            attributes.zIndex = 2
+            return attributes
+        }
+        var foldLeading = leading
+        var foldTrailing = trailing
+        var firstFoldingItem = 0
+        var lastFoldingItem = lastItem
+        var isOuterHint = false
+        if let current,
+           let original = unpinnedFrameForItem(at: IndexPath(item: current, section: indexPath.section)),
+           let selected = attributesForItem(at: IndexPath(item: current, section: indexPath.section), dragOffset: dragOffset) {
+            let pinnedLeading = original.minX < leading + (current > 0 ? peek : 0)
+            let pinnedTrailing = original.minX > trailing - (current < lastItem ? peek : 0)
+            isOuterHint = (indexPath.item == current - 1 && pinnedLeading) || (indexPath.item == current + 1 && pinnedTrailing)
+            // The selected tab becomes the inner edge of the remaining scrollable strip.
+            if pinnedLeading, indexPath.item > current {
+                foldLeading = min(trailing, selected.frame.maxX)
+                firstFoldingItem = current + 1
+            } else if pinnedTrailing, indexPath.item < current {
+                foldTrailing = max(leading, selected.frame.minX - attributes.frame.width)
+                lastFoldingItem = current - 1
+            }
+        }
+        // Tabs nearer the middle cover the folded stack; outer hints stay directly below the flare.
+        let middle = (foldLeading + foldTrailing + attributes.frame.width) / 2
+        attributes.zIndex = isOuterHint ? 0 : -Int(abs(attributes.center.x - middle))
+        let foldRange = min(attributes.frame.width / 2, (foldTrailing - foldLeading) / 2)
+        if foldRange > 0 {
+            if indexPath.item > firstFoldingItem, origin < foldLeading + foldRange {
+                origin = foldLeading + foldedDistance(origin - foldLeading, range: foldRange)
+            } else if indexPath.item < lastFoldingItem, origin > foldTrailing - foldRange {
+                origin = foldTrailing - foldedDistance(foldTrailing - origin, range: foldRange)
+            }
+        }
+        attributes.frame.origin.x = min(max(origin, foldLeading), foldTrailing)
+        return attributes
+    }
+
+    private func foldedDistance(_ distance: CGFloat, range: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
+        // Start easing the next tab when the outer tab is halfway covered.
+        let remaining = max(0, distance + range)
+        return remaining * remaining / (4 * range)
+    }
+
+    func unpinnedFrameForItem(at indexPath: IndexPath) -> CGRect? {
+        super.layoutAttributesForItem(at: indexPath)?.frame
+    }
+
+    func frameForRevealingItem(at indexPath: IndexPath) -> CGRect? {
+        guard let collectionView, let frame = unpinnedFrameForItem(at: indexPath) else { return nil }
+        let visibleWidth = collectionView.bounds.width - collectionView.adjustedContentInset.left - collectionView.adjustedContentInset.right
+        let current = currentIndex?()
+        let hasOuterNeighbor = current.map {
+            $0 < indexPath.item ? $0 > 0 : $0 < collectionView.numberOfItems(inSection: indexPath.section) - 1
+        } ?? false
+        let pinnedPeek = hasOuterNeighbor ? min(frame.width / 2, max(0, (visibleWidth - frame.width) / 2)) : 0
+        let pinnedWidth = current != nil && current != indexPath.item ? min(frame.width + pinnedPeek, max(0, visibleWidth - frame.width)) : 0
+        // Leave a glimpse of neighboring tabs without squeezing the selected tab on narrow strips.
+        let peek = min(frame.width / 2, max(0, (visibleWidth - frame.width - pinnedWidth) / 2))
+        var revealFrame = frame.insetBy(dx: -peek, dy: 0)
+        // A pinned current tab covers the neighbor hint unless its width is also reserved.
+        if let current, current < indexPath.item {
+            revealFrame.origin.x -= pinnedWidth
+        }
+        revealFrame.size.width += pinnedWidth
+        return revealFrame.intersection(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: collectionView.contentSize))
+    }
+}

+final class TabsBarLayoutTests: XCTestCase {

+    private let accuracy: CGFloat = 0.001

+        let cell = TabsBarCell(frame: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 120, height: 40))
+        let attributes = UICollectionViewLayoutAttributes(forCellWith: IndexPath(item: 0, section: 0))
+        attributes.frame = cell.frame
+        attributes.zIndex = -200
+        cell.apply(attributes)
+        let stackingAnimation = CABasicAnimation(keyPath: "zPosition")
+        stackingAnimation.fromValue = -200
+        stackingAnimation.toValue = 2
+        stackingAnimation.duration = 0.3
+        cell.layer.add(CABasicAnimation(keyPath: "position"), forKey: "edgeBounce")
+
+        for applyStyle in [true, false] {
+            cell.layer.add(stackingAnimation, forKey: "zPosition")
+            if applyStyle {
+                cell.applyCurrentStyle(isCurrent: true, isNextCurrent: false, hidesInactiveCloseButton: true,
+                                       withTheme: ReaderTabsTheme())
+            } else {
+                cell.apply(attributes)
+            }
+            XCTAssertEqual(cell.layer.zPosition, 2)
+            XCTAssertNil(cell.layer.animation(forKey: "zPosition"), "Selected content must stay above the flare throughout selection")
+            XCTAssertNotNil(cell.layer.animation(forKey: "edgeBounce"), "Position animations should be preserved")
+        }
+    }

+@MainActor
+protocol ScrollableTabBarContent: AnyObject {
+    var view: UIView { get }
+    var selectionHandler: ((AnyHashable) -> Void)? { get set }
+    var intrinsicHeight: CGFloat { get }
+

+struct ScrollableTabBarPresentationItem {
+    let id: AnyHashable
+    let title: String
+    let image: UIImage?
+    let accessibilityIdentifier: String?
+}

+/// A tab selector whose overflow items remain reachable through horizontal pagination.
+///
+/// Use ``delegate`` to receive user selection. See <doc:SelectionOwnership> for state
+/// ownership and event behavior.
+@MainActor
+public final class ScrollableTabBar<ID: Hashable>: UIView {
+    /// A tab presented by ``ScrollableTabBar``.
+    public struct Item: Identifiable {
+        /// The stable identity used for selection.
+        public let id: ID
+
+        /// The text describing the tab.
+        public var title: String
+
+        /// An optional image shown when the active UIKit presentation supports it.
+        public var image: UIImage?
+
+        /// An optional identifier for UI automation.
+        public var accessibilityIdentifier: String?
+
+        /// Creates a tab item with stable identity and display content.
+        public init(
+            id: ID,
+            title: String,
+            image: UIImage? = nil,
+            accessibilityIdentifier: String? = nil
+        ) {
+            self.id = id
+            self.title = title
+            self.image = image
+            self.accessibilityIdentifier = accessibilityIdentifier
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// The current membership and display order of the control.
+    ///
+    /// Use ``setItems(_:selectedID:)`` to update items and selection together.
+    public private(set) var items: [Item]
+
+    /// The identifier of the selected item, or `nil` when no item is selected.
+    ///
+    /// Assigning this property updates the presentation without sending
+    /// a delegate callback. A non-`nil` identifier must belong to ``items``.
+    public var selectedID: ID? {
+        get { selectedIDStorage }
+        set {
+            if let newValue {
+                precondition(
+                    itemIndexByID[newValue] != nil,
+                    "ScrollableTabBar selectedID must identify one of its items."
+                )
+            }
+            selectedIDStorage = newValue
+            renderContent()
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// The object notified when the user selects a different item.
+    ///
+    /// The tab bar does not retain its delegate.
+    public weak var delegate: (any ScrollableTabBarDelegate<ID>)?
+
+    /// A Boolean value that determines whether the user can change the selection.
+    public var isEnabled = true {
+        didSet {
+            renderContent()
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// The contextual accessibility label propagated to the active presentation.
+    public override var accessibilityLabel: String? {
+        didSet {
+            renderContent()
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// The identifier propagated to the active presentation for UI automation.
+    public override var accessibilityIdentifier: String? {
+        didSet {
+            renderContent()
+        }
+    }

+    // Capping the preferred width prevents spare title area from becoming empty glass
+    // while retaining overflow as a normal presentation state.

+    private var itemIndexByID: [ID: Int]
+    private var selectedIDStorage: ID?

+    ///

+    /// one of the supplied items. Empty items and no selection are supported.

+        items: [Item] = [],
+        selectedID: ID? = nil
+    ) {

+
+        self.items = items
+        self.itemIndexByID = itemIndexByID
+        selectedIDStorage = selectedID
+        content = Self.makeContent(

+        setContentHuggingPriority(.defaultLow, for: .horizontal)

+            UITraitPreferredContentSizeCategory.self,
+        ]) { (self: ScrollableTabBar, _) in

+        }
+        renderContent()
+    }

+    ///

+    /// reordering, or editing tabs. Identifiers must be unique and a non-`nil`
+    /// `selectedID` must identify one of the new items. Pass `nil` to clear the
+    /// selection, including when removing every item. Existing IDs retain their
+    /// identity even when their display content or position changes.
+    public func setItems(_ items: [Item], selectedID: ID?) {
+        let indices = Self.indices(for: items, selectedID: selectedID)
+        let wasEmpty = self.items.isEmpty
+        self.items = items
+        itemIndexByID = indices
+        selectedIDStorage = selectedID
+
+        let presentationItems = Self.presentationItems(items)
+        let selectedIndex = selectedID.flatMap { indices[$0] }
+        if wasEmpty || items.isEmpty {
+            replaceContent(Self.makeContent(items: presentationItems, selectedIndex: selectedIndex))
+        } else if !content.setItems(presentationItems, selectedIndex: selectedIndex) {
+            replaceContent(AdaptiveTabContent(items: presentationItems))
+        }

+        invalidateIntrinsicContentSize()
+        setNeedsLayout()
+    }

+    @available(*, unavailable)
+    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
+        nil
+    }

+    public override var intrinsicContentSize: CGSize {
+        CGSize(width: Self.preferredMaximumWidth, height: content.intrinsicHeight)
+    }
+
+    public override func sizeThatFits(_ size: CGSize) -> CGSize {
+        let proposedWidth = size.width > 0 && size.width.isFinite
+            ? min(size.width, Self.preferredMaximumWidth)
+            : Self.preferredMaximumWidth
+        return CGSize(
+            width: proposedWidth,
+            height: content.heightThatFits(size)
+        )
+    }

+        super.layoutSubviews()
+        content.view.frame = bounds
+        content.view.layoutIfNeeded()
+    }

+        // A menu action can outlive the item snapshot that created it.
+        guard itemIndexByID[id] != nil, isEnabled else {
+            renderContent()
+            return
+        }

+    }

+    }

+                title: $0.title,
+                image: $0.image,

+    }

+        items: [ScrollableTabBarPresentationItem],
+        selectedIndex: Int?

+    }

+import CommandPalette
+import SwiftUI
+#if os(iOS)
+import UIKit
+#endif
+
+struct LibraryCommandPaletteAdapter: View {
+    @Bindable var manager: iOSNavigationManager
+    let onDismiss: () -> Void
+
+    private var commands: [Command] {
+        // This is the original library's canonical filtered book membership, not another
+        // search model or a second search-history store. IDs include the canonical locator.
+        let books = manager.libraryViewModel.bookLookup.values.map(\.book)
+        var seen = Set<String>()
+        return books.sorted { $0.book.localizedStandardCompare($1.book) == .orderedAscending }.compactMap { book in
+            let id = book.backendLocator?.persistenceKey ?? "book:\(book.id)"
+            guard seen.insert(id).inserted else { return nil }
+            return Command(book.book, id: id, section: "ספרים", symbol: "book.closed") {
+                manager.openBook(book)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    var body: some View {
+        #if os(iOS)
+        EscapeCommandHost(onEscape: onDismiss) {
+            palette
+        }
+        #else
+        palette
+        #endif
+    }
+
+    private var palette: some View {
+        CommandPaletteView(
+            commands: commands,
+            placeholder: "חפש ספר בספרייה…",
+            initialQuery: manager.libraryViewModel.searchQuery,
+            autofocus: true,
+            queryBinding: Bindable(manager.libraryViewModel).searchQuery,
+            onDismiss: onDismiss
+        )
+        .accessibilityIdentifier("reader-library-command-palette")
+    }
+}
+
+#if os(iOS)
+/// Keeps the original palette in the responder chain of a real UIKit key command.
+/// SwiftUI's cancel shortcut is consumed by the focused text input on iPadOS.
+private struct EscapeCommandHost<Content: View>: UIViewControllerRepresentable {
+    let onEscape: () -> Void
+    let content: Content
+
+    init(onEscape: @escaping () -> Void, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) {
+        self.onEscape = onEscape
+        self.content = content()
+    }
+
+    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> EscapeCommandHostingController<Content> {
+        EscapeCommandHostingController(rootView: content, onEscape: onEscape)
+    }
+
+    func updateUIViewController(_ controller: EscapeCommandHostingController<Content>, context: Context) {
+        controller.rootView = content
+        controller.onEscape = onEscape
+    }
+
+    func sizeThatFits(
+        _ proposal: ProposedViewSize,
+        uiViewController: EscapeCommandHostingController<Content>,
+        context: Context
+    ) -> CGSize? {
+        let width = min(proposal.width ?? 640, 640)
+        let measured = uiViewController.sizeThatFits(in: CGSize(width: width, height: 10_000))
+        return CGSize(width: width, height: measured.height)
+    }
+}
+
+private final class EscapeCommandHostingController<Content: View>: UIHostingController<Content> {
+    var onEscape: () -> Void
+
+    init(rootView: Content, onEscape: @escaping () -> Void) {
+        self.onEscape = onEscape
+        super.init(rootView: rootView)
+    }
+
+    @MainActor @preconcurrency required dynamic init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {
+        fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented")
+    }
+
+    override func viewDidLoad() {
+        super.viewDidLoad()
+        // The original palette owns its rounded material and shadow. The
+        // UIKit bridge must not paint a rectangle outside that source shape.
+        view.backgroundColor = .clear
+        view.isOpaque = false
+    }
+
+    override var canBecomeFirstResponder: Bool { true }
+
+    override var keyCommands: [UIKeyCommand]? {
+        let command = UIKeyCommand(
+            input: UIKeyCommand.inputEscape,
+            modifierFlags: [],
+            action: #selector(handleEscape(_:))
+        )
+        command.wantsPriorityOverSystemBehavior = true
+        // Keep the original SwiftUI hosting controller's other commands.
+        return [command] + (super.keyCommands ?? [])
+    }
+
+    override func canPerformAction(_ action: Selector, withSender sender: Any?) -> Bool {
+        if action == #selector(handleEscape(_:)) {
+            return viewIfLoaded?.window != nil
+        }
+        return super.canPerformAction(action, withSender: sender)
+    }
+
+    @objc private func handleEscape(_ command: UIKeyCommand) {
+        // Resign the palette's real input before removing its hosting view.
+        view.endEditing(true)
+        onEscape()
+    }
+}
+#endif
+
+/// The owner's compactSearchField, with only library-domain text/icon/binding substituted.
+struct SafariLibrarySearchField: View {
+    @Binding var query: String
+    var quickAddressFocused: FocusState<Bool>.Binding
+    let onExpand: () -> Void
+
+    var body: some View {
+        HStack(spacing: 11) {
+            Image(systemName: "books.vertical")
+                .font(.system(size: 17, weight: .medium))
+                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+            TextField("חיפוש בספרייה", text: $query)
+                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
+                .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .medium))
+                .foregroundStyle(.primary)
+                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
+                .autocorrectionDisabled()
+                .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
+                .focused(quickAddressFocused)
+                // A native toolbar's TextField consumes its ancestor's tap.
+                // Observe the same tap without replacing the original field
+                // or changing the supplied source's appearance/focus behavior.
+                .simultaneousGesture(TapGesture().onEnded { _ in onExpand() })
+                .submitLabel(.search)
+                .onSubmit(onExpand)
+                .accessibilityLabel("חיפוש בספרייה")
+                .accessibilityIdentifier("reader-library-search-field")
+            Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
+                .font(.system(size: 18, weight: .regular))
+                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
+        }
+        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
+        .frame(height: 52)
+        .contentShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 26))
+        .onTapGesture(perform: onExpand)
+        .modifier(SafariGlass(radius: 26))
+    }
+}
